verdict: Leads softened this week; cost per lead is rising and being addressed.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 172 leads at $12.36 per lead on $2,126.57 in ad spend — all from the active Meta campaign. In the most recent 7 days, lead volume dropped 27% while cost per lead rose 36% on nearly unchanged spend, a clear sign the current ad creative is fatiguing with its audience. Creative is being refreshed to arrest that trend. Separately, 172 leads entered the pipeline this period but zero appointments or opportunities are recorded in the CRM — meaning leads are arriving but not being worked, which is a contact-and-intake issue, not an ads issue. Resolving SMS automation and voice access for the team is the immediate priority so leads can be reached before they go cold.

watch_item.issue: Leads are entering the system but not advancing — zero appointments logged against 172 leads this period.
watch_item.fix: SMS automation and voice access are being activated now so the team can contact and qualify leads without delay.
